# Hooks (30)

> Provenance: 30 HookEvent members. The 30 HookEvent members, verbatim from node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk/sdk.d.ts:802 (the HookEvent union), SDK 0.3.160. Order matches capture.ts HOOK_EVENTS. The `expectation` is an INITIAL TAG only from 021's prior evidence (2026-06-04 hook-coverage-pass, 2026-06-08 dormant-hooks): fired_known = already fired on a wrapped run; conditional = a config lever should fire it (the battery sets the lever); unreachable_headless = expected to need a feature absent from a headless container (TUI/teammate). The battery attempts EVERY hook; the ledger records fired | proven_unreachable, never the expectation. Nothing is pre-excluded except kernel/eBPF (out of scope).

Each hook, the trigger mechanism that fires it, and the channel(s) a real row must land on.
